ABOUT THIS STUDENT PROJECT

About the Student Resource Locator

This independent prototype brings together UCCS and Colorado Springs resources from three supplied research documents. It was developed for a Bachelor of Innovation student resource project and is not an official or endorsed UCCS service.

How to use the directory

  1. Search by a name or a need, or choose a category.
  2. Refine by location, cost, or access type.
  3. Open a resource for contact details, official links, and source notes.
  4. Save useful resources with the bookmark button. Saves stay in this browser.

What the source labels mean

Official details checked: specific fields were cross-checked with a provider page on October 23, 2026. This is a point-in-time review, not a guarantee of current availability.

Official link available: a provider, calendar, or historical page was located, while the specific offering may still need confirmation.

From student research: the listing comes from the supplied documents and could not be independently verified. “Not listed” means information is missing; it does not mean no requirements apply.

Cost filters use checked cost information only. “Free options” can include a limited number of free sessions or a free component; read the full terms. No live opening-hours or inventory feed is connected.

Research sources

  • Extensive Student Resource List.docx — October 2026; the primary inventory.
  • At a Glance Student Resources.docx — cross-reference and additional limits.
  • Printable UCCS Resources Reference Sheet.pdf — page 1, including additional support and funding entries.

Repeated Farm references are combined into one listing. Commercial offers and named community services are separated so they can be found individually. Original document excerpts are preserved within each resource.

Known gaps and corrections

Most document entries do not provide hours, contacts, or documentation requirements. Event recurrence, emergency grant amounts, special giveaways, some software access, and unnamed community offerings need further review.

Corrections include eight Clyde’s Closet items per semester, paid SOLE equipment rentals, limited Metro pass availability, three-week PPLD hotspot loans, a one-time printing credit, and the official pool closure notice. Each affected resource explains its source conflict.

Keep the directory useful

Confirm details through the provider’s official page. Contact the provider using the listed phone or email if information appears outdated. This prototype does not submit correction reports.

Understand and maintain the project

The directory uses plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a separate JSON resource file. No framework, database server, or external search API is required. The October 31 interface update preserves all 178 existing records and their organization. Resource information retains its earlier review dates and was not reverified during this visual update.
